Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Manoj - 31 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Pallavi - 64 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Sunita - 28 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Anil - 38 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Manoj stands in the ward. Pallavi and Anil stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Manoj checks Mother's pulse.]

Manoj: "Yes, of course."

[Manoj lies down on the hospital bed.]

Manoj: "That's easy."

[Manoj sits in a wheelchair.]

Manoj (softly): "I knew it!"

[Manoj walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Manoj: "Show me too!"

[Manoj coughs and holds his chest.]

Pallavi: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Pallavi and Anil stand near him.]

Manoj: "Let's begin."

[Manoj drinks a beer.]

Manoj: "Oh wow!"

[Manoj's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Manoj: "Anil, look at this."

[Manoj waves at his sister on a video call.]

Anil: "One more time!"

[Manoj dies in the fire.]

Anil (laughing): "No… this cannot be!"
